algorithm: value = round(12000 * exp(-0.0165 * (rank-1)) / rank**0.18). 1QB multiplies QB value by 0.38. Picks map to equivalent ranks on that curve.

sf.label: Superflex Dynasty
sf.blurb: Uses The Keep Superflex Dynasty ranks. Rank 1 is 12,000 BK Value. Quarterbacks keep full Superflex price.

sfr.label: Superflex Redraft
sfr.blurb: Uses The Board Superflex Redraft ranks. This-year Superflex. No dynasty pick chips.

oneqb.label: 1QB Dynasty
oneqb.blurb: Same Ball Keep ranks as Superflex Dynasty, but quarterbacks are taxed to 38% of that value because there is no second QB slot.

ppr.label: Redraft PPR
ppr.blurb: Uses the Redraft PPR board rank. Same curve, one-year contest, no dynasty pick chips.

std.label: Redraft Standard
std.blurb: Uses the Redraft Standard board rank after the PPR-to-Standard positional taxes.
